_brief: Batch 2026-10-03 item 11, MIC ON STREET / PILOT. Tal: "Please edit the Pilot video as well." WHAT IT IS (38 transcripts read, frames looked at): not a pilot episode - a mic stand on the Tel Aviv promenade where passers-by record a message for 'Captain Smith', an Indian airline pilot who was hurt protecting Israeli passengers on a flight the day before and is in hospital. The folder also holds FINAL VIDEOO.mov, a 141.8s string-out of 17 messages end to end. SHAPE DECIDED: a street-interview chorus (formats/street-interview.md), 9 beats / 8 people, no intro and no title: cold open on the mother ('Smith, we can't thank you enough. You're a hero.') -> who and why, in a stranger's words ('thank you for saving my Israeli brothers on the plane') -> Uganda -> the couple ('you are welcome to Israel at any time') -> the thesis 5th ('it doesn't matter what walk of life, what religion, where you're from ... we need more people like you in the world') -> two women ('Thank you so much!') -> 'the Israeli people are forever in debt to you' -> the mother again ('We'll have you for Shabbat dinner') -> END 'From the people of Israel to the people of India, we love you, we stand with you ...' with his arms wide. Never two similar people in a row. LESSONS 80: no zooms; every shot is the full frame except the mother, who gets ONE constant tighter frame (1.5x) because her baby is in the stroller at the bottom of the full frame (LESSONS 81: a child's face is not shown; checked on 11 stills that the baby is outside the crop). Tal's premise ('a great hero ... injured badly', 'the Indian pilot that got stabbed') is left out: the answers explain it and it keeps the film on gratitude. grade:false (iPhone daylight, LESSONS 72). Sound: LOCATION-SOUND.wav (soundtrack.py: one denoise per run, one static gain per run).

beats: COLD OPEN 9553 mother with a stroller: 'Smith, we can't thank you enough. You're a hero.' Constant 1.5x frame that keeps the baby out of picture.
9502 young man, striped shirt - who and why: 'Yo, thank you for saving my Israeli brothers on the plane. Really appreciate it. Kudos to you, my friend.' (out before Tal's 'Perfect' 24.58)
9556 man from Uganda: 'Hey buddy, we love you so much. I'm from Uganda. Thank you very much for saving people, and we will be with you. Thank you very much. Cheers.'
9549 couple: 'You are welcome to Israel at any time. We love you. You are our hero.' (in after the prompt 'you are speaking to him...'; out before 'Wish you' 13.22)

THE THESIS, 5th: 9500 young man, white tee: 'And you taught us all a lesson that it doesn't matter what walk of life you are, what religion, where you're from, you went out there and you saved the lives of strangers, and we need more people like you in the world.'
9542 two women in white: 'Thank you so much!' (one run of speech 2.3-3.4 by RMS; the cached word stamp 'Thank 0.78-2.02' is a smear)
9509 older man, shirtless: 'Thank you so much for your strength and courage. The Israeli people are forever in debt to you. Thank you.'
9553 the mother again, same constant frame: 'We love you. We'll have you for Shabbat dinner.'

END 9544 young man, arms wide: 'From the people of Israel to the people of India, we love you, we stand with you, and we need to fight against all forms of hate together.' Out on his open arms (10.2), before he drops them (10.6).
